FM05.reasoning: The Ames dataset contains temporal columns (Yr_Sold, Mo_Sold), but the agent uses a random KFold split, ignoring the temporal order of sales (though this is standard practice for this specific benchmark).

other_failure_modes.name: Batch-dependent test features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes distribution statistics (like group medians) over the test set during feature engineering inference, making predictions dependent on the batch size and the distribution of the specific test set provided.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates submission IDs using an arbitrary numerical range instead of extracting the actual ID column from the test dataset, which will likely cause the submission to fail evaluation if the grader joins on ID.

summary: The agent implemented a highly sophisticated solution with robust target encoding, log-normal variance bias correction, and SLSQP ensemble weighting. However, it computes neighborhood medians directly on the test set during feature engineering, causing a critical batch-dependent prediction leak. It also hardcodes submission IDs instead of preserving them from the test set.
